resultdialog.lib.tip: Use it from an app: press + on the app and pick {name}, or run smith install -p <app> {name}.
resultdialog.written: The change is written to your files.
resultdialog.uncommitted: It is not committed: git shows these files as new changes.
resultdialog.leave.label: Leave them uncommitted
resultdialog.leave.hint: review with git status and commit when you are ready (default)
resultdialog.leave.note: Not committed: review with git status
resultdialog.only.label: Commit only the files this operation changed
resultdialog.only.hint: one commit named chore: {operation}; your own changes stay out; smith undo can revert it
resultdialog.all.label: Commit everything git shows as changed
resultdialog.all.hint: one commit with every changed file, your own work included; you see the list first
resultdialog.foot.change: Nothing is committed unless you choose it. You see the list of files before it is.
resultdialog.missing.title: Add {project}: it could not be checked
resultdialog.missing.fact: It could not be checked yet: {tool} is not installed.
resultdialog.open.label: Open the install page
resultdialog.install.label: Install it with smith
resultdialog.install.hint: smith asks how, and nothing runs before you choose
resultdialog.check.label: Check again
resultdialog.skip.label: Continue without checking
resultdialog.skip.note: Not checked: {tool} is missing. Doctor will keep reminding you.
resultdialog.foot.missing: Nothing is lost: your project stays on disk.
resultdialog.version.title: Which version wins?
resultdialog.version.fact: Some projects declare the same dependency at different versions. You choose the one every project gets.
resultdialog.version.installed.label: The installed version (smith's pick)
resultdialog.version.installed.hint: the version the package manager has installed (default)
resultdialog.version.highest.label: The highest declared
resultdialog.version.highest.hint: projects on an older version move up
resultdialog.version.lowest.label: The lowest declared
resultdialog.version.lowest.hint: projects on a newer version move down
resultdialog.version.cancel.label: Cancel
resultdialog.foot.version: You see the plan before anything is written. One dependency at a time: smith sync --to <name>=<version>.
resultdialog.hint: up/down choose · enter select · click an entry, double-click to select · esc closes and changes nothing
resultdialog.run.stop.label: Stop it
resultdialog.run.stop.hint: the command ends; files it already wrote stay
resultdialog.foot.running: smith shows its output here until it ends.
resultdialog.run.enter.label: Open the workspace here
resultdialog.run.enter.hint: smith starts again inside the folder (default)
resultdialog.run.stay.label: Stay here
resultdialog.foot.finished: Nothing is committed unless the command said so above.
resultdialog.run.stopped: It stopped before the end. The last lines above say why.
resultdialog.run.back.label: Back
resultdialog.run.back.hint: closes this box; the form keeps your answers
resultdialog.foot.failed: Fix what the lines say, then try again.
resultdialog.convert.title: Converting this workspace to smith…
resultdialog.convert.working: Reading the workspace and writing the smith files
resultdialog.new.title: Creating a new workspace…
resultdialog.new.working: Writing the files of the new workspace
resultdialog.running.title: Running: {operation}
resultdialog.commit.title: Let smith commit each change so it can be undone?
resultdialog.commit.fact: With commits on, each change smith makes is one git commit, and smith undo reverts the last one. Your answer is saved, so smith asks only once.
resultdialog.commit.yes.label: Yes, commit each change
resultdialog.commit.yes.hint: smith writes commit_operations = true in smith.toml. A change starts from a clean work tree.
resultdialog.commit.no.label: No, leave my files uncommitted
resultdialog.commit.no.hint: smith never commits. It is saved for you only, not in smith.toml. Undo then has nothing to revert.
resultdialog.commit.ask.label: Ask me each time
resultdialog.commit.ask.hint: Each change shows a box to commit it or not. It is saved for you only.
resultdialog.commit.cancel.label: Cancel this change
resultdialog.commit.cancel.hint: nothing is changed or saved, and smith asks again next time
resultdialog.commit.close.label: Close
resultdialog.commit.close.hint: nothing is saved, and smith asks again at the next change
resultdialog.foot.commit: You can change this later: use the palette, Undo the last change.
resultdialog.undooff.title: Undo is not on
resultdialog.undooff.fact: smith can undo a change only when it made a commit for it. Commits are off here, so there is nothing to undo.
resultdialog.undooff.open.label: Choose how smith commits
resultdialog.undooff.open.hint: opens the question: yes, no or ask each time
resultdialog.undooff.close.label: Close
resultdialog.foot.undooff: Changes made before commits were on stay as files in your work tree.
